choice.description: What is the interest payable for Interest Period 9 of loan TL-88-2291?

contexts:
CALDERWOOD REGIONAL BANK — COMMERCIAL LENDING: INTEREST PERIOD STATEMENT CHECK
Facility: term loan TL-88-2291, borrower Mistral Cold Storage LLC. Currency USD.

Facility agreement (extract)
§5.1 Interest accrues daily on the principal outstanding at the start of each day, from and including the first day of an Interest Period to but excluding its last day.
§5.2 Day count: actual number of days elapsed divided by 360.
§5.3 Rate: the Fixed Margin Rate applicable on each day. The rate applicable from 15 January 2028 is 4.20 % p.a. Upon a rate fixing, the new rate applies from and including the Reset Date, which is the second Business Day after the fixing date. Business Day: Monday to Friday, other than a day on which banks in New York are closed.
§5.4 Voluntary prepayment: a prepayment reduces the principal outstanding from the start of the day on which the prepaid funds are received by the Bank. Prepayments do not change the Interest Period dates.
§5.5 Interest for each Interest Period is payable on its last day and rounded to the nearest cent.
§5.6 Default interest (+2.00 %) applies only to overdue amounts; none outstanding.

Interest Period 9: 15 January 2028 – 15 April 2028.
Principal outstanding on 15 January 2028: USD 250,000.00.
Events in Interest Period 9:
- Borrower instructed a voluntary prepayment of USD 50,000.00 on Monday 31 January 2028 (instruction time 16:40); funds received by the Bank Tuesday 1 February 2028.
- Rate fixing on Monday 28 February 2028: new Fixed Margin Rate 4.65 % p.a.
- Bank holidays (New York) in the period: Mon 17 Jan 2028, Mon 21 Feb 2028. No other closures.
- Borrower's treasury asked on 3 March 2028 whether the interest could be computed on a 30/360 basis "as in our previous facility TL-71-0843"; request declined, agreement unchanged.

Calendar reference: 2028 is a leap year (February has 29 days); 28 February 2028 is a Monday, 1 March 2028 a Wednesday.
